title: Average annual glacier ice loss by period
geography: Global (excluding Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets)

source.name: Glacier Mass Balance Intercomparison Exercise (GlaMBIE)
source.publisher: World Glacier Monitoring Service (WGMS), University of Zurich

notes: WGMS/GlaMBIE estimate average annual glacier ice loss (excluding the Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets) rose from under 100 billion tonnes/year in 1976-1995, to about 230 billion tonnes/year in 1996-2015, to about 390 billion tonnes/year in 2016-2025. Figures approximate as publicly reported.
